summary: Re-tested TonAer contact success and failure states plus desktop/mobile homepage smoke flows.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-prefixed contact lead through the valid live API regression test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Contact success, forced network failure error state, desktop homepage load, mobile menu open/close, and mobile horizontal overflow were verified. No application APIs are mocked; the browser failure test aborts only its request to simulate an outage.
rca of the issue: Previous false-success regression is resolved: App.js now sets submitError in the POST catch path and only sets sent after a successful response. Opening the form also clears prior success/error state.
